messages.content: What actions can you offer me for event management, seasons and settings? Do not prepare or execute any change.

actions.name: svc.athlete.coverage.check
actions.label: Check coverage
actions.about: How each athlete's holdings stand on on_date.

actions.name: svc.competition.catalogue.history
actions.label: Catalogue history
actions.about: One catalogue's history, newest first. Memberships and insurance are asked by year; the entry-fee grid by season_id, as it stays seasonal. The service refuses the wrong one for the catalogue. The paym

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.confirm
actions.label: Waive an entry's fee
actions.about: svc.competition.entry.confirm's request: waive an entry's fee, from the Athletes tab's row menu. A manager can no longer waive the insurance requirement — that was reversed; an entry still owing cover

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.message.log
actions.label: Message the account holder
actions.about: svc.competition.entry.message.log's request: a fact the caller already carried out (an email actually sent), not a decision this service makes — logged here so the per-surfer timeline lives in one pla

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.promote
actions.label: Entry promote
actions.about: svc.competition.entry.promote's request: moves an alternate into a vacated place in the field, from the Athletes tab's row menu.

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.retry.prepare
actions.label: Retry the card payment
actions.about: svc.competition.entry.retry.prepare's request. This service never sends a cmd.* (invariant — only the gateway holds the signing key), so it says whether the entry's charge may be retried and who to ch

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.wildcard.quote
actions.label: Entry wildcard quote
actions.about: What the athlete's wild card checkout costs, for the entry's account holder. A read.

actions.name: svc.competition.entry.withdraw
actions.label: Withdraw entry
actions.about: svc.competition.entry.withdraw's request: a tour manager pulling a surfer out of the field, from the Athletes tab's row menu.

actions.name: svc.competition.entry_fee.defaults.get
actions.label: Get entry fee defaults
actions.about: The fee grid's cell for this season, primary region and rating.

actions.name: svc.competition.entry_fee.grid.get
actions.label: Get entry fee grid
actions.about: One season's whole fee table.

actions.name: svc.competition.entry_fee.grid.set
actions.label: Set entry fee grid
actions.about: Save the grid. Nothing is live until this is sent.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.alternates.move_up
actions.label: Event alternates move up
actions.about: Move the alternates who are ready into the seats nobody holds: the first alternates in line, in order, one for each open seat. Charges no one: a moved-up surfer arrives waitlisted and is charged on th

actions.name: svc.competition.event.alternates.move_up.undo
actions.label: Event alternates move up undo
actions.about: Put everyone moved up and not yet charged back at the front of the alternates, in their old order. Refused when there is nobody to put back (competition.nothing_to_undo); the other refusals are the mo

actions.name: svc.competition.event.archive
actions.label: Archive event
actions.about: Into the Archived band, read-only; the way back is status.set to Draft.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.copy
actions.label: Copy event
actions.about: A copy of source_event_id, always Draft, in the source's own season. fields is the prefilled form the manager may have edited before confirming — the service does not re-derive it from the source, it

actions.name: svc.competition.event.create
actions.label: Create event
actions.about: A new event, always Draft.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.entries
actions.label: Event entries
actions.about: One event's seed list.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.entries.order.set
actions.label: Save the seed list order
actions.about: Save a dragged seed order. order is every entry that is not withdrawn and every empty wild card slot (WildcardSlotSummary.slot_id), each once, in the order dragged; version is the seed list's, from th

actions.name: svc.competition.event.hub_summary
actions.label: Event hub summary
actions.about: The Events Hub's strip, for the events the list's filters keep. Takes the list's filters and nothing of its view, sort or page: the strip follows a filter but not a tab.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.opening.cancel
actions.label: Cancel a scheduled opening
actions.about: Call off an opening scheduled for later. The event stays confirmed with no registration window; refused unless one is scheduled (competition.opening_not_scheduled). Answered with EventDetailReply.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.registration_window_default.get
actions.label: Get event registration window default
actions.about: The registration window a form may fill in for an event with this start date at this location — never stored by itself.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.registrations
actions.label: Event registrations
actions.about: The Athletes tab while entries are open: everyone entered, in entry order.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.search
actions.label: Search event
actions.about: One page of a season's events.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.star.set
actions.label: Set event star
actions.about: Stars are per account: the caller is the token's sub.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.status.set
actions.label: Change event status
actions.about: Move to status, which must be one of the event's status_options. This is the only write of the registration window.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.update
actions.label: Update event
actions.about: acknowledged_conflicts is accepted but ignored — see EventCreateRequest; the same deployed-BFF compatibility applies here.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.assign
actions.label: Event wildcard assign
actions.about: Give the slot to an athlete. A new entry is made for an athlete not in the event; an athlete already in it has their own entry moved into the seat, their old seat closes up, and the first alternate ta

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.candidates
actions.label: Event wildcard candidates
actions.about: Whether each athlete a search found may be given a wild card in this event. A read.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.change
actions.label: Event wildcard change
actions.about: Give a wild card seat to someone else: the athlete holding it (entry_id) is cancelled, and athlete_id takes the same seat and type, as event.wildcard.assign would give it to them.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.remove
actions.label: Event wildcard remove
actions.about: Take a wild card seat back: the athlete holding it is cancelled, and the seat is an empty slot of the same type again.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.slot.add
actions.label: Add event wildcard slot
actions.about: Add an empty wild card slot at seat. Every seat from there down moves one place, and whoever is pushed past the last seat becomes the first alternate.

actions.name: svc.competition.event.wildcard.slot.delete
actions.label: Delete event wildcard slot
actions.about: Delete an empty slot. Every seat below it moves up one.

actions.name: svc.competition.field.confirm
actions.label: Confirm and charge the field
actions.about: svc.competition.field.confirm: the tour manager starts the entry-fee charges for these entries of one event.

actions.name: svc.competition.field.confirm.preview
actions.label: Preview field confirm
actions.about: svc.competition.field.confirm.preview: what confirming this field would do, before anybody commits to it.

actions.name: svc.competition.format.catalogue
actions.label: Format catalogue
actions.about: Every format preset this organisation holds, for the Settings tab.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.archive
actions.label: Archive insurance
actions.about: Hide a product from sale. Never a delete: credits and entries name it.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.catalogue
actions.label: Insurance catalogue
actions.about: One policy year's products, archived ones included — or the current year's.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.create
actions.label: Create insurance
actions.about: Record a product the broker has issued. Creates no cover. Answers with the year's InsuranceCatalogueReply.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.grid.set
actions.label: Set insurance grid
actions.about: Save every changed product in one year at once.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.policy.download
actions.label: Download insurance policy
actions.about: A link to one product version's policy PDF.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.update
actions.label: Update insurance
actions.about: Edit a product: a new version replaces it, and the old one is kept for what was already sold against it.

actions.name: svc.competition.insurance.year.add
actions.label: Add insurance year
actions.about: Copy the latest year's products into the year after it. Answers with an InsuranceCatalogueReply for the new year.

actions.name: svc.competition.location.archive
actions.label: Archive location
actions.about: Archive a venue, which is the only way one leaves the picker.

actions.name: svc.competition.location.catalogue
actions.label: Location catalogue
actions.about: Every venue this organisation holds, for the Settings tab.

actions.name: svc.competition.location.list
actions.label: List location
actions.about: Active locations only; include_location_id adds that one even once archived, so an event keeps showing the venue it already has.

actions.name: svc.competition.location.unarchive
actions.label: Unarchive location
actions.about: Put an archived venue back in the picker.

actions.name: svc.competition.membership.grid.get
actions.label: Get membership grid
actions.about: One year's membership prices, or the current year's.

actions.name: svc.competition.membership.grid.set
actions.label: Set membership grid
actions.about: Save a year's grid. Rows are renamed and repriced, never added or removed: the memberships are a closed set. A price change is stored as a new product version, so a membership already sold keeps what

actions.name: svc.competition.membership.year.add
actions.label: Add membership year
actions.about: Copy the latest year's grid into the year after it. Answers with a MembershipGridReply for the new year.

actions.name: svc.competition.payment_rules.get
actions.label: Get payment rules
actions.about: The current rules.

actions.name: svc.competition.payment_rules.set
actions.label: Set payment rules
actions.about: Save what changed. A field left out is left alone, so a form read before someone else's save cannot undo it; a list sent is the whole list.

actions.name: svc.competition.season.copy
actions.label: Copy season
actions.about: Copy season_id's tours and events into a new season, every event a Draft, dates shifted by the gap between the two start dates.

actions.name: svc.competition.season.copy.preview
actions.label: Preview season copy
actions.about: What copying season_id into a new season with these dates would create. A read: nothing is written until season.copy.

actions.name: svc.competition.season.create
actions.label: Create season
actions.about: name is typed by the manager, pre-filled from the dates chosen — 2026 for a calendar-year season, 2026-27 for one spanning two — but not derived here. The dates are validated by the service, which che

actions.name: svc.competition.season.list
actions.label: List season
actions.about: Empty on purpose. The caller's organisation is the org_id claim of the access token; a field here would be a parameter the service has to refuse rather than a fact it already holds.

actions.name: svc.competition.tour.create
actions.label: Create tour
actions.about: The event form's "Create tour": a tour missing from the dropdown.

actions.name: svc.competition.tour.format.list
actions.label: List tour format
actions.about: The event format presets for a tour's family; empty for an unknown tour.

actions.name: svc.competition.tour.rating.list
actions.label: List tour rating
actions.about: The ratings a tour's events can carry. An unrated tour (CT, CS), or an unknown one, answers an empty list rather than an error.

**Events**
- Create an event, copy one, or edit its details.
- Move an event to its next status, such as tentative, confirmed, open for entries (now or at a set time), closed, reopened or cancelled.
- Call off an opening you scheduled for later.
- Archive an event, or bring an archived one back to draft.
- Star events so they show in your starred view.
- Seed lists and entries:
  - Save a new seed order.
  - Add, give, change or remove wild card slots.
  - Withdraw an entry, or waive an entry's fee (you pick the reason).
  - Move alternates into open seats, one at a time or all ready ones together, and undo that.
  - Retry a failed card payment.
  - Log a message sent to an account holder.
- Confirm and charge the field. I'd always show you the preview of the charges first.
- Look things up: event overviews, history, registrations, seed lists, the default registration window and the events hub summary.

**Seasons and tours**
- Create a season, or copy one into a new season. Copied events start as drafts with dates shifted, and I can preview the copy first.
- Create a tour, and look up tours, their formats and their ratings.

**Settings**
- Entry-fee grid: view or save a season's fees, including each region's currency and tax.
- Memberships: view or reprice a year's prices, or start the next year from the current one.
- Insurance: add, edit or archive products, save a year's products at once, start a new policy year, and download policy documents.
- Venues: create, edit, archive or unarchive.
- Payment rules: view or update them.
- Event formats: view the presets.
- The change history of each of these.

I can also open any of these pages for you. Just say what you'd like to do.

stream.answer:
Priority means the surfer who holds it has the unconditional right of way to catch any wave they choose. Others in the heat can still paddle for and catch that same wave, but only if they don't hurt the priority surfer's chance to score ("Priority", Appendix D – Definitions, 2026 WSL Rule Book, p.125).

How it works depends on how many surfers are in the heat:

- **Two-surfer heats:** Once the first wave of the heat is ridden, the other surfer automatically gets priority for any wave they choose. After that, priority keeps passing back and forth each time the surfer holding it rides a wave (Rule 11.14, 2026 WSL Rule Book, p.83).
- **Three-surfer heats:** The first surfer to ride a wave drops to third priority. The other two both have priority over that surfer and can paddle for waves without losing their place (Rule 11.15, 2026 WSL Rule Book, p.83).
- **Four-surfer heats:** It works the same way. The first surfer to ride a wave drops to fourth priority, and the other three have priority over them (Rule 11.16, 2026 WSL Rule Book, p.84).
- **Overlapping heats:** Each heat uses two-surfer priority, shown and announced separately for each heat. Surfers in the heat that started first have unconditional priority over those in the second heat (Rule 11.02, 2026 WSL Rule Book, p.77).

In practice, catching a wave usually sends you to the back of the order. Surfers who paddle for a wave but miss it generally keep their spot, though the exact conditions are in Rules 11.11 and 11.13(j).
